units.source_text: 自我在江川初次看到的时候起，也许还不太会蹬球，

en.t: From the time I first saw them in Egawa, they were perhaps still not very good at ball-kicking,

units.source_text: 技艺还不高明，演《八木小调》时有顾客出出入入，

en.t: their skills were not yet polished, and customers came and went during the performance of Yagi Kouta,

units.source_text: 只是能表演令人毛骨悚然的脚上功夫的女人和艺术家所演出的艺术——

en.t: but the art performed by the woman and the artists, who could show footwork chilling enough to make one shudder,

units.source_text: 准备打头阵的矮个子那番雄辩的开场白倒是很鲜见的。

en.t: and the eloquent opening speech by the short man who was to lead things off, were truly something rare.

units.source_text: 毋宁说，我在小田原看了地道的蹬球技艺。

en.t: Rather, it was in Odawara that I saw genuine ball-kicking artistry.

units.source_text: 我打算去伊豆温泉场旅行，晃悠悠离开东京到了小田原，

en.t: I was planning to travel to the hot-spring resorts of Izu, and after drifting out of Tokyo I arrived in Odawara,

units.source_text: 已是日暮时分，天下着雨，所以就在小田原歇宿。

en.t: but it was already dusk and it was raining, so I stayed the night in Odawara.

units.source_text: 借了旅馆的雨伞，走出去散步，顺便走进戏棚里，

en.t: Borrowing an umbrella from the inn, I went out for a walk and happened to enter a theater booth,

units.source_text: 看见两个挺可爱的小姑娘在表演蹬球技艺。

en.t: where I saw two rather charming little girls performing ball-kicking tricks.

units.source_text: 约莫十一岁的小姑娘在蹬球的闲暇时，

en.t: The girls, who were about eleven years old, in the intervals between their ball-kicking,

units.source_text: 一人演烟花女，一人扮男装当大名演古装戏，

en.t: performed a period play in which one played a courtesan and the other dressed as a man to play a daimyo,

units.source_text: 最后大名杀了烟花女，帷幕就落下来了。

en.t: and in the end the daimyo killed the courtesan, and the curtain came down.

units.source_text: 舞台后面仅距三尺，就是小田原的海。

en.t: Only about three feet behind the stage was the sea of Odawara.

units.source_text: 这次旅行头一夜的舞台场面，清楚地留在我的记忆里。

en.t: The stage scene from the first night of that journey remains clear in my memory.

units.source_text: 这女孩子蹬球的脚下功夫真是巧妙极了。

en.t: The girl’s footwork in kicking the ball was truly wonderfully skillful.
